title: Built a NIFTY Options Buying Bot — Should I Go Live With It?
author: Ok_Wheel1089
selftext:
I've spent the last few months building and backtesting an automated intraday strategy. Before I put real money on it, I'd love this community's honest opinion — tear it apart if you can.

**The idea:** Buy NIFTY options (CE or PE) when a short-term trend ignites, lock profits fast with a ratcheting trailing stop, exit same day. Fully automated on Zerodha, starting with 1 lot.

**Entry rules (5-min candles, NIFTY futures):**

* Supertrend (10,3) sets direction
* Price 5+ points beyond VWAP, VWAP sloping the same way
* RSI 50–85 for calls / 25–55 for puts
* ADX ≥ 15 (skip sideways markets)
* Skip narrow/doji candles (range < 0.7 × ATR)
* Trades 9:20 AM – 2:30 PM only, buys ITM weekly options

**Exit rules (where most of the work went):**

* Hard stop: Rs 2,000/lot, placed broker-side the second entry fills
* After +10 points in my favor, a trail activates: exit on a 4-point giveback from peak
* Stop trigger ratchets up every candle close — the broker fires it intra-bar, so protection survives bot crashes
* Flat by 3:15 PM, no overnight positions
* Daily circuit breaker: −Rs 2,500/lot ends the day (\~2 stop-outs)

**3-year backtest (includes Rs 120/trade costs + 1 pt slippage):**

* \~1,650 trades/year, win rate \~80%
* Avg win \~Rs 700 vs avg loss \~Rs 2,150 — one SL eats \~3 winners, the 80% win rate is what makes it work
* **Net \~Rs 2.1L/year per lot, profit factor 1.30, max drawdown \~Rs 69K**
* 56% of days green, 67% of weeks, 81% of months
* **The ugly part I want opinions on: 2023 would have LOST \~Rs 56K.** It needs trending markets and bleeds in low-VIX chop. 2024: +2.6L, 2025: +3L.

**My questions before going live:**

1. **Would you go live with this?** PF 1.30 with one losing year in three — is that enough edge for real money, or am I fooling myself with an overfit backtest?
2. The economics are thin: \~Rs 116 expected profit per trade. How much real-world slippage/spread damage should I budget for in NIFTY weekly ITM options beyond my 1-pt assumption?
3. Any filter that genuinely worked for you to skip chop months? (I tested VIX-proxy and PCR-style gates — all cost more than they saved in backtest)
4. What failure mode am I not seeing? Infra handles: exchange SL-M ban, broker modify limits, crash recovery, partial fills.
5. If you'd size it: how much capital per lot would you keep against that 69K drawdown?

Brutal honesty appreciated — I'd rather be embarrassed here than funded and wrong.
